communication_goal: 先测量延迟，再判断优化对象，避免凭感觉归因。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Make named learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI marks allowed. Scene: Two adult stick figures beside a large wall-mounted graph board centered, clean single line graph with horizontal and vertical axes, one prominent peak midway. NO axis numbers or words. Left developer gestures toward peak without covering it, right colleague holds open palm thoughtfully. Entire plotted graph and rectangular board visible. No other charts or clock.

coverage_review.scope: W034 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

inversion.note: 原图保留；本卡发布用图为原图精确 RGB 反色（黑底白线）。

image_review.summary: 通过：两名开发者讨论性能测量，中央图板完整，单峰曲线与两轴清楚，无数字或文字；手势避开峰值。数据库是否瓶颈仍为假设，不用示意曲线证明因果。
